verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere supports system prompts, tool calling, and chat sessions that could be combined to build a task-specific assistant, but there is no dedicated 'assistant/persona' object, no way to save/name/reuse a configured assistant, and no docs describing multi-assistant management. missing for 10: a first-class custom-assistant/persona API or config format, ability to save and switch between multiple named assistants, and any hands-on/community evidence of building specialized assistants.
